verdict.rationale: Conta Simples publishes a public developer portal with a quickstart, OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth with scoped credentials, and an API reference with an interactive playground. The reference covers broad programmatic control: cards, virtual cards, bills, balance, statements, categories, cost centers, suppliers, users and receipts. Docs are also agent-friendly, available as Markdown and indexed via llms.txt. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found none at standard paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working in practice.
